title: Add imagePullPolicy to k8s base manifests
description:
**Severity: MEDIUM**

**File**: `deploy/k8s/base.yaml` (all Cordum service containers)

**Issue**: No `imagePullPolicy` set on any container. Cordum service images use no tag (implicit `latest`), but default policy for untagged images varies by k8s version, leading to unpredictable behavior.

**Fix**: Add explicit `imagePullPolicy: Always` to all containers, or pin image tags and use `IfNotPresent`.
definitionOfDone: All Cordum service containers in base.yaml have an explicit imagePullPolicy
Policy choice is consistent across all containers

implementationPlan.description: Add `imagePullPolicy: Always` to all 6 Cordum service containers in base.yaml (lines 207, 262, 329, 412, 503, 570) — `cordum-context-engine`, `cordum-safety-kernel`, `cordum-scheduler`, `cordum-api-gateway`, `cordum-workflow-engine`, `cordum-dashboard`. Third-party images (nats:2.10, redis:7) already have explicit tags and can keep the default policy.

Note: This is a companion to Task 11 (pin image tags). Once tags are pinned, `imagePullPolicy` can be changed to `IfNotPresent` for faster rollouts. For now, `Always` is the safe default for untagged images.
Validate with `kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f deploy/k8s/base.yaml` (or just visual review if no cluster available).

reopenReason: No changes made since first rejection. All 6 Cordum containers still use imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent. Images in base.yaml are untagged (implicit :latest), so IfNotPresent causes stale cached images — worse than the k8s default for :latest which is Always. Required fix: change all 6 occurrences from IfNotPresent to Always.
